rationale: Manish brings deep ML infrastructure and computer vision expertise from Meta and Palo Alto Networks, while Ariadne is building LLM-powered enterprise agents at Avenir AI with a focus on AI safety and hallucination mitigation. Their complementary strengths—Manish's production ML systems experience and Ariadne's research-backed approach to reliable AI guardrails—align well for exploring how robust ML infrastructure can underpin safer, domain-aware agent systems in enterprise applications.
intro_message: Manish kumar Keshri, meet Ariadne Dulchinos — both of you are solving critical challenges at the intersection of ML systems and reliable AI deployment, and your backgrounds in production ML and AI safety could spark some valuable ideas.
